Tales of Aravorn: Seasons of the Wolf.summary: ToA: Seasons Of The Wolf is a RPG set in same world of Loren The Amazon Princess. The romance is still present but the game provides a much better experience on the RPG gameplay part, with isometric maps, randomized loot, many skills and clever AI.

Tampon Run.title: Tampon Run
Tampon Run.summary:
Tampon Run is a game created to combat the taboo around menstruation. In this game you will need to help Luna rid the world of menstruation haters! Throw tampons at them and don’t let them confiscate yours!
How many enemies can you enlighten?

Team Indie.title: Team Indie
Team Indie.summary: Team Indie unites indie video game characters into one play experience. You will play coop with your own prior runs and bend time to get through puzzles and action sequences. Characters like CommanderVideo from Bit.Trip Runner or Clunk from Awesomenauts join forces, each one with their unique skill to cooperatively get through the jump 'n run levels.

Terra Battle.title: Terra Battle
Terra Battle.summary: Created by many of the minds which developed the original Final Fantasy games, Terra Battle is a strategy RPG puzzle-game. Recruit various heroes of different classes and with different skills, and pit them against the computer\'s enemies.

The Blackwell Epiphany.title: The Blackwell Epiphany
The Blackwell Epiphany.summary: The Blackwell Epiphany is the last game in the Blackwell series.

The Castle Doctrine.title: The Castle Doctrine
The Castle Doctrine.summary: The Castle Doctrine is a massively-multiplayer game of burglary and home defense. It's 1991, and things are bad. You're a guy with a house and family. Other players are coming to take what's yours. Build security to stop them. Study their houses, buy tools, and break in to take what's theirs. Everything you do is permanent

The Deer God.title: The Deer God
The Deer God.publisher: Cinopt Studios, Mobot Studios, Inc, Level 77 Pty Ltd, Crescent Moon Games
The Deer God.summary: The Deer God is a breathtaking 3D pixel art adventure that will challenge your religion and your platforming skills. It's a game about survival, reincarnation, and karma; all set in a breathtaking and unique 3D pixelized world. Feast your eyes on the beautiful lighting, day and night system, and vast landscapes.

The Ensign (video game).title: The Ensign
The Ensign (video game).summary: The Ensign is a text-based RPG and prequel to A Dark Room. It follows a perilous journey through a desolate world where death is frequent but teaches valuable lessons. Players must balance aggression and caution, manage survival resources, and uncover the events leading up to A Dark Room, with moral choices shaping the experience.

The Idolmaster One For All.title: The Idolmaster: One For All
The Idolmaster One For All.summary: The Idolmaster: One For All is a Japanese raising simulation video game in The Idolmaster series. The story in One For All is told from the perspective of a producer in charge of leading and training a group of pop idols to stardom. Its gameplay, while most similar to its predecessor The Idolmaster 2, features several improvements and differences, and allows players to produce all 13 idols from 765 Production, the main talent agency featured in the series. The office environment was redesigned to give it a more natural feeling, and a focus was put on "returning to the starting point" in The Idolmaster series with One For All centered on growing alongside novice idols in a small talent agency.

The Last Federation.title: The Last Federation
The Last Federation.summary:
From the creators of AI War: Fleet Command comes an all-new grand strategy title with turn-based tactical combat, set in a deep simulation of an entire solar system and its billions of inhabitants. You are the last of a murdered race, determined to unify or destroy the 8 others.

As the last remaining Hydral, it is up to you to create a lasting federation of planets and usher in an era of peace and prosperity to the solar system. Bring spacefaring technology to underdeveloped societies, manipulate their economies, political systems, and diplomatic relations. Do whatever it takes to end strife in your solar system. Remember, when helping civilizations evolve, sometimes they evolve faster when a large multi-headed monster is glaring menacingly at them.

The Letter (video game).title: The Letter
The Letter (video game).summary: The player takes the role of a young boy, Michael Kennedy, who receives a mysterious letter from his missing father and begins a quest to find him.

The Marvellous Miss Take.title: The Marvellous Miss Take
The Marvellous Miss Take.summary: The stealth genre gets turned on its head in The Marvellous Miss Take - the only heist adventure that invites you to steal with style! Use cunning, guile and the art of deception to grab the loot and escape without getting caught by the guards!

The Muppets Movie Adventures.title: The Muppets Movie Adventures
The Muppets Movie Adventures.summary: Join Kermit the Frog, Miss Piggy, The Great Gonzo, Animal and more of the Muppets as the zany gang bring their unique blend of laughs, chaos and adventure to the Hollywood stage.

The Red Solstice.title: The Red Solstice
The Red Solstice.summary:
8-player co-op strategy/RPG set on Mars during The Red Solstice

In The Red Solstice you control one of the eight space marines that are trying to find out what happened to human colonies on Mars during the huge storm called The Red Solstice. The mix of a dark and gritty Science Fiction setting and addictive adrenaline filled gameplay - based on advanced tactics and quick decisions at the same time - makes for a great atmosphere and gameplay experience.

The Stomping Land.title: The Stomping Land
The Stomping Land.summary:
The Stomping Land is a multiplayer survival game about living in a world with dinosaurs.
Form tribes, build traps, and hunt down earth's historic beasts with the goal of becoming the most dominant tribe on the island.

The Uncle Who Works for Nintendo.title: The Uncle Who Works for Nintendo
The Uncle Who Works for Nintendo.summary: The Uncle Who Works for Nintendo is a Twine horror game created by developer, Michael Lutz and illustrator, Kim Parker.

Thinking with Time Machine.title: Thinking with Time Machine
Thinking with Time Machine.summary: Thinking with Time Machine is a Portal 2 mod in which you will find and use a Time Machine to create a twin of yourself from the past to help you solve the puzzles. The past self accurately repeats all of the player's actions, creating a unique twist on familiar Portal game mechanics.

Tokyo 7th Sisters.title: Tokyo 7th Sisters
Tokyo 7th Sisters.summary: Tokyo 7th Sisters is a fully-voiced rhythm / idol raising simulation game with card battling components developed by Donuts Co. Ltd. Originally released in Japan for iOS on February 2014 and later released for Android devices on November 2014.

Touch Detective 3.title: Touch Detective 3
Touch Detective 3.summary: The mystery solving duo, Mackenzie and Funghi, return once again in a new adventure on the Nintendo 3DS.

Town of Salem.title: Town of Salem
Town of Salem.summary: Town of Salem is a game that challenges players on their ability to convincingly lie as well as detect when other players are lying. The game ranges from 7 to 15 players. These players are randomly divided into alignments - Town, Mafia, Serial Killers, Arsonists and Neutrals. If you are a Town member (the good guys) you must track down the Mafia and other villains before they kill you. The catch? You don't know who is a Town member and who is a villain. If you are an evil role, such as a Serial Killer, you secretly murder town members in the veil of night and try to avoid getting caught.

Train Fever.title: Train Fever
Train Fever.summary:
Train Fever is a railroad-focused business simulation game. In other words, it's a modern-day Transport Tycoon with procedural content and a sophisticated city simulation.
It's the year 1850, and there are great times ahead! Establish a transport company and be its manager. Build infrastructure such as railways and stations, purchase transportation vehicles and manage lines. Fulfill the people's needs and watch cities evolve dynamically.

Two Dots (video game).title: Two Dots
Two Dots (video game).summary: Two Dots is a puzzle video game for iOS and Android, developed and published by American indie studio Playdots, Inc. The Windows 10 Mobile and Microsoft Windows versions are no longer supported. It is the sequel to Dots.

War Robots.title: War Robots
War Robots.summary: War Robots is an action-packed multiplayer game with 6 vs. 6 team battles in real-time! Join the ranks of the Mighty Warriors!

Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon.title: Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon
Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon.developer: The Lordz Games Studio, Flashback Games
Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon.summary: In this hex-based, turn-based strategy game, players will lead the Imperial forces of the Armageddon Steel Legion and Space Marines from a variety of Chapters against the Ork invasion through over 30 scenarios, on the hostile terrain of the planet and its gigantic Hive Cities.

Warhammer 40,000: Carnage.title: Warhammer 40,000: Carnage
Warhammer 40,000: Carnage.summary:
All New Playable Character, Exclusive Levels and New Flamer Weapons!
New and Improved Fireteams! We've made it easy to find and recruit your Friends.

Run and gun through screaming hordes of frenzied enemies in this fast-moving, high powered, action side-scroller. Jump into the kick-ass Warhammer 40,000 universe, obliterating infernal Orks in this stunning world. Warhammer 40,000: Carnage is built for anyone who loves fast action, and destroying stuff, and lots of it!!

Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf
Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf.summary:
Lead the Sons of Russ into battle and slash your way through hordes of ferocious enemies with Boltgun fire and Chainsword teeth. Write your own saga in the annals of the Space Wolves Chapter as you hunt your sworn enemies - the Chaos Space Marines.

Savour the atmosphere, as you play this unique combination of turn-based strategy and collectible card game, where you can turn defeat into victory, where events on the battlefield depend on a wise choice of cards and decisions must be planned meticulously.

Warhammer 40,000: Storm of Vengeance.title: Warhammer 40,000: Storm of Vengeance
Warhammer 40,000: Storm of Vengeance.summary:
Warhammer 40,000: Storm of Vengeance is a lane strategy game set in the dark, gothic universe of Warhammer 40,000.

Warhammer 40,000: Storm of Vengeance tells the story of a pivotal moment in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, during the legendary planetary conflict on Piscina IV. Featuring two of Games Workshop's most cherished characters, Grand Master Belial and Ork Warlord Ghazghkull Thraka, Storm of Vengeance offers the player the chance to command the tenacious defence of the planet with only 100 Dark Angel Space Marines, or attempt it's annihilation using the cunning of the Ork Waaagh! and their telly-porta technology.

Warlock II: The Exiled.title: Warlock II: The Exiled
Warlock II: The Exiled.summary:
Warlock 2: The Exciled expands on the enchanting world of Ardania. The world has been shattered, and you have been exiled to one of its many shards. The time has come to return to Ardania and seek vengeance on those who cast you out. Battle through the fractured realms inhabited by other exiles, hostile Mages and terrifying creatures. Once back in Ardania you will face your greatest threat: The Four Vicars of the United One. Conquer all who oppose you, reclaim your home and take your revenge.

Warlock 2 is a turn-based strategy game of fantasy warfare. Rival against Great Mages, lead mighty armies into fierce battles, wield ancient magic, use cunning diplomacy and faith as your weapons. Experience the challenge in single or multiplayer.

White Cat Project.title: White Cat Project
White Cat Project.summary: White Cat Project is a free-to-play action role-playing game developed and published by Colopl for Android and iOS.

With Those We Love Alive.title: With Those We Love Alive
With Those We Love Alive.summary: A short Twine adventure that blends digital and physical interaction. In the game The Player takes the role of the slave of a monstrous queen in a fantasy world, until an old friend appears seemingly out of nowhere.

Wonder Flick.title: Wonder Flick
Wonder Flick.summary: Wonder Flick was a role-playing video game developed and published by Level-5, which was released for iOS and Android devices. Versions for the Wii U, PlayStation Vita, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One were also planned but were eventually cancelled upon the shutdown of the mobile version in 2015. Vita.

Word Puttz.title: Word Puttz
Word Puttz.summary: Word Puttz is a hybrid word-tile and mini-golf puzzle game developed by Jackbox Games. Players progress through levels by creating crossword-style words on a grid, aiming to reach a designated goal marked as a golf cup. The game features a character named Octoputtz—an octopus—who operates themed mini-golf courses that introduce various gameplay elements such as environmental obstacles and unconventional challenges. As players advance, they can earn stars, interact with in-game objects like mollusks, and unlock additional stages or worlds.

World War II: TCG.title: World War II: TCG
World War II: TCG.summary: World War II: TCG is a free-to-play collectible card game. Create your own Army Deck with Tanks, Infantry, Aircrafts, Ships, Submarines and Structures!

World of Warriors.title: World of Warriors
World of Warriors.summary: History’s toughest warriors find themselves summoned to a land beyond our own. In this mysterious kingdom, known as the Wildlands, the only way to survive… is to fight!

Wrack (video game).title: Wrack
Wrack (video game).summary: "Wrack is an arcade-style FPS that draws inspiration from classic games across multiple genres -- Doom, Contra, Mega Man, etc. -- that puts its own unique spin on things! Between its fun and unique gameplay, its vibrant cel-shading, and its compelling characters, Wrack strives to be a modern day classic!"

Ziggurat (2014 video game).title: Ziggurat
Ziggurat (2014 video game).summary:
Dungeon-Crawling First Person Shooting at its finest! Fast-paced combat! Dozens of perks, spells and enemies! Level ups! Random Dungeons! Traps! Badass bosses! Carrots! Ziggurat is the best combination of First Person Shooter and Rogue-LITE you have ever seen.

Become a neophyte sorcerer, and get ready for your rite of passage: Enter the labyrinth and face dangerous challenges to prove your worth and become a powerful wizard!

The game focuses on fast-paced first person shooting, with an old-school vibe, and updated handling and game mechanics. Dungeon crawling and RPG/Roguelike elements are added into the mix, resulting in a fun, challenging and varied game, with lots of content to discover.

Fight almighty bosses, get through rooms filled with traps, and treasures that may help you in your journey... Each game is a whole new experience!
